desc: Derive the fixed-value contribution using suffix subsets and the beta-integral identity.
Relate exclusion of one element to the full grouped polynomial and simplify the final weighted sum by digit-length classes.
Implement efficient polynomial multiplication under modulus 998244353 using NTT, including binomial class polynomials.
Handle \(N=1\), exact decimal digit boundaries, modular factorials/inverses, and validate against the sample \(N=3\).
